lines.en: label sportswars14:
scene mayachasing1
: Hey! Asshole! When I said I had legs, I didn’t mean it was okay for you to make me wear them down until there’s nothing left!
: Just how long are you planning on keeping this up for?! How many more miles do we need to walk until you realize how much of a coward you’re being right now?!
: You can turn around and leave whenever you want.
: And give you the satisfaction of escaping me and thinking that this is something you can run from too?! Fuck that! This is a problem you created! And I’m still polite enough to try and fix it!
: Go home.
: I don’t have a home!
: You have the dorm, don’t you? And with Ami gone, you’ve got the room all to yourself. I’d be excited if I were you.
scene mayachasing2
: Oh, yeah! Nothing says “exciting” like spending months and months alone in a room and waiting for someone to come visit! That always works out great for me! Just, here’s the thing-
scene mayachasing1
: No one fucking visits me anymore!

: Well...no one except Ayane. But I’m starting to think the actual Ayane was abducted by aliens and replaced with a well-made clone who is now attempting to probe me for information. And not in the good way either!
scene mayachasing3
: Just tell me what you want, please. What can I do to make you leave me alone?
: I’ve been telling you what I want since the moment I had to slap your sorry ass out of another blackout at the shrine! I want an explanation!

: You don’t do this to me! I’m the exception! I’m the one who’s special to you! But now there’s all this shit with Noriko and- since when the fuck are you talking to Niki again?! Is that what this is about?!
: Are you trying to disappear on me now?! After all I’ve done for you?! After all we’ve done together?!
: Is this a hobby of yours?! Making one girl fall for you just to scramble to a different one the second shit gets too hard?! Did Ami remove your backbone while you were unconscious or something???
: If I tell you it’s because of Niki, will that be enough to make you leave?
scene mayachasing4
: Don’t even joke about that...
: You know how I feel about her. And we agreed that we wouldn’t-
: See, that’s the problem. I’ve never agreed to anything with you.
: Sensei. Come on. You know that’s not true.
: Maybe not from your perspective. But from mine, it seems like you’re the one who was abducted by aliens and replaced with a well-made clone.
: So well-made, in fact, that I can’t even look at you without being overcome by every single emotion known to man.
: With all due respect, I have a hard time believing you can feel more than a maximum of three emotions. Let alone all of them at once.

: But given that those are the same three emotions I am able to have, I can empathize with where you’re coming from and will not think less of you for how much you want to strangle, embrace, and fuck me right now.
: Go home.
: Take me to yours.
: I have no idea what all of this bullshit Clone-yane has got you on is, what with me “not being the same Maya” or whatever the fuck, but I am. I am me. Nothing has changed.
: Everything has changed. But you’re the last person I want to talk to about it. And you need to understand that because just being around you is making this so much harder than it already is.
scene mayachasing3
: Have you thought for a second that maybe it’s only hard in the first place because you want it to be that way? It’s not like you’ve never intentionally torn your life to shreds before, Sensei.
: But that’s why I exist. I’m here to pick up those pieces and put you back together so that you can do the same thing for me when I decide to act all suicidal for months on end.
: That’s how the cycle works. That’s the system we’ve created.

: You break, I fix. I break, you fix. Then, we fill the radio silence with sex and our shitty idea of what “affection” means until we’re too tired to keep our eyes open and fall asleep next to one another.
: Only metaphorically though. Because Ami’s gotten way too close to finding us in bed before and, with this suddenly heightened suspicion of hers, I’m not about to take any chances on-
scene mayachasing5
: What part of “leave” don’t you understand?!
scene mayachasing6
: The “leave” part!
: That’s the whole thing!
: Yeah! And it’s a thing I’ve never had to deal with before because you’ve always wanted me around! And now that you either don’t or are pretending to not want me, I’m fucking confused!
: Well, I’d be confused too if I suddenly woke up in a world that was entirely different from what I was used to.
scene mayachasing7
: Oh my god. This shit again? Really?
: That happened to me once, you know. Maybe more than once.
: But even with how confused and how lost I was navigating a brand new world, there was a light there- guiding me along. Pissing me off and annoying me every step of the way.
: I feel like it would have been the other way around. But please, do proceed with your maniacal ramblings about alternate universes and whatever version of me you allegedly liked screwing the most.
: The Maya I know would never chase after me like this. She was far too jaded and far too busy worrying about other things. Bigger things.
scene mayachasing8
: She never gave a shit about how I felt or how I acted.
: Or, at least that’s how she seemed on the surface. I’m sure those things got to her internally if the way we felt at the end was at all indicative of her feelings on the way there.
: But that was just the thing.
: It was so hard to figure out what she was feeling. And now you’re here wearing your heart on your sleeve and chasing after me when we both know I’m not worth it.
: Sensei, I’m only chasing after you because I’ve run out of options. And yeah, it’s a bit uncharacteristic, but I have a feeling you’d do the same for me if you ever had to.
scene memories1
scene memories17
scene memories23
scene mayachasing3
: Besides, what does being worth it even mean? We’re both all sorts of fucked up and, in the grand scheme of things, I can’t imagine anyone else ever finding us worth it in the first place.
: My Maya was a lot more conceited as well.
: Oh, don’t get me wrong. I am a fucking catch. But only on the outside.
scene mayachasing9
: In here, I’m just as bad as you. I only give a shit about two people- and I’ve lied to one of them more times than I can even count.
: I’m explosive. Sensitive. And, despite everything happening right now, I hate confrontation. Hell, I’m probably even emotionally abusive at times.
: But you were the one who helped me understand that it’s okay to be imperfect. That, so long as we can figure out a way to function out here, it doesn’t matter who we really are.

: Are you giving up on that? Are you so tired of camouflaging yourself that you’re fine with just holing up in your bedroom and letting Ami spoon-feed you until you die of old age and lack of exercise?
: It’s not that I’m giving up. It’s that I’ve already lost everything that gave me a reason to go on in the first place.
: But you haven’t! I’m right here! You just have to turn around and see me for who I am now rather than who I was in whatever prolonged delusion apparently stripped me from your mind.
: Oh, right. That’s another thing.
: What’s another thing? What are you talking about now?
: See, you probably don’t know this yet on account of you being Kumon-mi’s latest teenage newborn, but my memory’s been essentially erased.
: What? What’s that supposed to mean?
: It means that the only thing I really know about “our” past together is the fact that there was a past at all. And every other memory I made along the way is something you’ve yet to experience.
: Quit fucking with me, Sensei. Memories don’t just disappear like that out of nowhere. And using that as an excuse to break things off is cowardly even for you.
: This isn’t the world you’re familiar with, Maya.
: It might seem like it is. But somewhere along the line, you got wrapped up in something terrible and confusing, then spat out back at the beginning as if it never happened at all.
: And I’m happy for you because it means you won’t have to suffer anymore. That’s where I come in.
: I’ve gotta give kudos to you, though. Well, the you that isn’t here anymore, I mean.
: Because if experiencing this reunion one time is enough to make me want to bite my tongue off, I can only imagine how it felt for her.
: Sensei...I’ve got no fucking clue what all of this “something terrible” or “fake amnesia” shit is about, but if hearing you out will stop you from running, then fuck it. I’ll listen.
: It’s one thing to have Ayane and, to a lesser extent, Makoto tormenting me about this on a weekly basis. But I trust you way more than I trust both of them.
scene mayachasing3

: But I also want you to know that I’m not just going to go along with any of this because, even if you are being sincere and your perception of the lives we’ve lived has been somehow mutilated, it’s not real.

: I am Maya Makinami. I am the best and worst secret you have ever kept. And I am the type of girl who will chase you down if I have to because not even a million time-loops could stop me from doing that.
: How many would it take then?
: A million and one. I have to set a limit somewhere, you know.
scene mayachasing10

: And hey, if this amnesia nonsense has any speck of truth to it at all, it’ll give you the pleasure of getting acquainted with me all over again. Which I’m sure would end up the same way it did last time.
: You and I just...work. Way better than we were ever supposed to. Which is precisely why I can do things like chase you across town like this is some scene out of a movie.
: The bad news is that I am very much no longer a virgin, so your reacquaintment will not include the pleasure of deflowering me unless I really am a clone and my hymen has regenerated.
: Which I hope it hasn’t because, as if I’m not too small for your massive penis now, boy were things tough back in the study room.
: Go home, Maya. I don’t want to do this with you.
scene mayachasing11
: What if I break out my ultimate bargaining chip and go get my shrine maiden dress?
: I don’t want to do anything with you.

: I don’t want to see you. I don’t want to talk to you. I don’t want to hear your voice. I don’t want to smell your perfume. I don’t want to see your shadow beside mine. And I definitely don’t want to sleep with you.
: Yeah, because you’re still looking away. And you know that, the second you turn around, all of that will change since you’ll realize that I’m still me.
: And I’m pretty sure make-believe Maya would side with me here since she’s the only person around who could ever properly comprehend how attractive and awesome I am.
: If you want me to go home, take me there yourself...
: Then grab my shoulders, look me in the eyes, and decide what it really is you want.
: Because I know you better than you do, Sensei. Even if you’ve changed in the time we’ve spent apart.
: I know how to make the pain go away.
: I know how to remind you of who you really are beneath all of the madness.
: But most importantly-
: I know that today is a safe day and I’m sure I don’t need to explain to you why that is a thing you should be excited about.
scene mayachasing3
: Did that convince you? Can we finally stop walking now?
There’s a voice in the back of my head.
It’s quiet right now....but I can still feel it lingering.
I understand what it wants me to do.
But I don’t understand what I want to do.
Maybe this meat puppet won’t be that bad?
It has the same packaging as my former love, at least.
It’s likely tender...fresh.
Delectable in ways I only briefly got to experience before the world was ripped away again.
Besides...
It’s what she would want, isn’t it?
She had me while I was gone.
But I bet she waited longer.
I bet she struggled just as hard at first.
But I bet she waited longer.
scene black
: No...we’ve got plenty more walking to do.
: I’m taking you home.
: But your house is only a few blocks from-
: I’m taking you to a different one.
I bet she waited longer.
But hey.
I’ve got nothing to lose...remember?
Plus, this is what that voice in the back of my head wants.
If I can keep that at bay, maybe someone else might avoid my wrath next.
Maybe one less girl will find herself being sexually assaulted on the floor of a karaoke booth...
Or a dark room in a mansion...
Or surrounded by dilapidated buildings in the most evil part of town...
Maybe there’s someone it’s okay for me to hurt?
: A...different one?
Maybe that someone is her?
